summary: 015 is a self-hosted platform designed for temporary file sharing and text exchange. It allows users to upload content that is intended to be accessed once or for a limited duration. The application combines functionality typical of single-click file transfer tools and pastebins.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you frequently need to share single files or snippets of text quickly without leaving permanent data behind on your infrastructure.
watchOut: The project has a modest community footprint and moderate maintenance activity, meaning you may encounter rough edges or need to rely on the source code to resolve issues. The AGPL-3.0 licence also places strict copyleft requirements on any modifications you distribute.
deployNotes: Because the application is distributed as a Docker container, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
